disabled.description: Turn off the artifact tools and the local viewer

port.description: Port of the local viewer on 127.0.0.1. The next free port is used when it's taken

open_on_create.description: Open a new artifact in the browser when it's first published

allow_cdn.description: Let artifact pages load scripts from cdnjs, jsDelivr, unpkg, the Tailwind CDN and the jQuery CDN, and fonts from Google Fonts. Off by default: pages make no outside requests

trailer_style.description: Style of attribution trailer to add to commits

generated_with.description: Add Generated with Ta-Da line to commit messages and issues and PRs

daily.description: Daily budget in US dollars. When today's counted spend reaches it, Ta-Da asks before the next model call

session.description: Budget for one session in US dollars

warn_at.description: Percentages of a budget that show a warning. Defaults to 50, 75 and 90

max_depth.description: Maximum depth for the ls tool

max_items.description: Maximum number of items to return for the ls tool

models.description: Model configurations for different model types

hooks.description: User-defined shell commands that fire on hook events (e.g. PreToolUse)

env.description: Environment variables to set on startup

machines.description: Computers on your network that serve models, and how many agents each can run at once

name.description: Friendly display name shown in the TUI for this hook

matcher.description: Regex pattern tested against the tool name. Empty means match all tools.

command.description: Shell command to execute when the hook fires

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for the hook command

disabled.description: Whether this LSP server is disabled

command.description: Command to execute for the LSP server

args.description: Arguments to pass to the LSP server command

env.description: Environment variables to set to the LSP server command

filetypes.description: File types this LSP server handles

root_markers.description: Files or directories that indicate the project root

init_options.description: Initialization options passed to the LSP server during initialize request

options.description: LSP server-specific settings passed during initialization

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for LSP server initialization

disable.description: Turn off the dreamer (also turns off smart notes)

inject_docs.description: Inject ARCHITECTURE.md and STRUCTURE.md into the cached history block

endpoint.description: Base URL of an OpenAI-compatible API

model.description: Historian model: large (session model), small, or provider/model

two_pass.description: Run a second editor pass over each historian draft

auto_promote.description: Promote historian facts to project memory

message_param.description: Tool argument name that receives the reply text

suppress_tools.description: Additional tool names that suppress the automatic reply when the model already called one of them during the turn

tool.description: MCP tool name that sends the reply

target_param.description: Tool argument name that receives the reply target

target_meta.description: Channel meta attribute carrying the reply target; defaults to sender (user route) or group (group route)

command.description: Command to execute for stdio MCP servers

env.description: Environment variables to set for the MCP server

args.description: Arguments to pass to the MCP server command

cwd.description: Working directory for stdio MCP servers. Relative paths resolve against the project directory

url.description: URL for HTTP or SSE MCP servers

disabled.description: Whether this MCP server is disabled

disabled_tools.description: List of tools from this MCP server to disable

enabled_tools.description: Allow list of tools from this MCP server

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for MCP server connections

sessionless.description: Mark a sessionless MCP server (no Mcp-Session-Id) so Ta-Da skips the subscriptions/listen stream it would otherwise reject. Leave unset to auto-detect known sessionless servers (e.g. GitHub MCP)

headers.description: HTTP headers for HTTP/SSE MCP servers

oauth.description: Enable OAuth 2.1 authorization flow for this MCP server (HTTP transport only)

oauth_client_id.description: Pre-registered OAuth client ID for servers without dynamic client registration

oauth_client_secret.description: Pre-registered OAuth client secret paired with oauth_client_id

oauth_callback_port.description: Fixed localhost port for the OAuth callback

channel_enabled.description: Enable this MCP server as a channel (equivalent to --channels)

channel_reply.description: Automatically route replies for turns originating from this channel back through one of the server's tools

hardware.description: What the machine is, shown to the AI

url.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL of the machine's model server

type.description: Server type: openai-compat, ollama, lmstudio, llamacpp, omlx or litellm

api_key.description: API key for the server, if it needs one

model.description: Model agents on this machine use. Empty uses the first model the server reports

context_window.description: Context window to assume when the server doesn't report one

slots.description: How many agents the machine can run at once

tags.description: What the machine is good at, shown to the AI

role.description: The job the machine is assigned, shown to the AI

notes.description: Anything else the AI should know about the machine

disabled.description: Keep the machine configured but don't use it

enabled.description: Turn on Magic Context for the main agent. Replaces auto-summarize

execute_threshold_percentage.description: Context usage percentage at which queued drops apply and the historian runs (20-90)

execute_threshold_tokens.description: Absolute token threshold that overrides execute_threshold_percentage (min 5000)

protected_tokens.description: Newest tokens that are never dropped. Default is derived from the context window (min 4000)

keep_reasoning_tokens.description: Reasoning tokens kept in the live tail

history_budget_percentage.description: Fraction of usable context the session history may use (0.05-0.5)

cache_ttl.description: Provider prompt-cache lifetime. Queued drops wait for it to expire unless usage passes the threshold. Like 5m, 1h or never

temporal_awareness.description: Add time-gap markers and dates to history

protected_tools.description: Keep the newest N results of these tools out of drops (merged with todos:1 and ctx_reduce:3)

disabled.description: Turn off all importing from OpenCode

mcp.description: Import MCP servers from OpenCode config. A server with the same name in tada.json wins

providers.description: Import provider base URLs, API keys, headers and custom models from OpenCode config and honor its enabled_providers and disabled_providers. Values set in tada.json win

models.description: Extend the model catalog with OpenCode's locally cached models.dev catalog

credentials.description: Use API keys saved by opencode auth login. OAuth logins are never imported

instructions.description: Add OpenCode's instructions files and global AGENTS.md to the context

commands.description: Offer OpenCode's custom commands as opencode:<name> commands

tools.description: Apply OpenCode's global tools toggles to built-in tools and imported MCP servers. A toggle that any OpenCode agent turns back on is skipped

permissions.description: Apply OpenCode's edit: allow as prompt-free file edits inside the project and its whole-tool deny rules as disabled tools. Nothing else is imported

compaction.description: Turn off auto-summarize when OpenCode's compaction.auto is false and no OpenCode plugin is installed

context_paths.description: Paths to files containing context information for the AI

global_context_paths.description: Paths to files containing global context information for the AI

skills_paths.description: Paths to directories containing Agent Skills (folders with SKILL.md files)

debug_lsp.description: Enable debug logging for LSP servers

data_directory.description: Directory for storing application data. Relative paths are resolved against the working directory; absolute paths are used as-is.

disabled_tools.description: List of built-in tools to disable and hide from the agent

disable_provider_auto_update.description: Deprecated: has no effect. The provider catalog is never updated automatically; run tada update-providers to update it.

disable_default_providers.description: Ignore all default/embedded providers. When enabled, providers must be fully specified in the config file with base_url, models, and api_key - no merging with defaults occurs

initialize_as.description: Name of the context file to create/update during project initialization

auto_lsp.description: Automatically setup LSPs based on root markers

progress.description: Show indeterminate progress updates during long operations

notifications.description: Notification style to use. Options: auto (default), native, osc, bell, disabled. Auto selects based on environment: native for local sessions, osc for SSH (with automatic OSC 99/777 detection).

disabled_skills.description: List of skill names to disable and hide from the agent

request_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for each LLM API request. Streaming responses are aborted only after this much inactivity, so slow but active streams are never killed. 0 disables it, negative values are invalid.

opencode.description: Import MCP servers, providers, models, rules, skills, commands, tool toggles and file-edit permissions from a local OpenCode install. Read from disk only; never fetched

enable_web_tools.description: Enable the built-in tools that make outbound network requests for the agent (fetch, agentic_fetch, download, sourcegraph). The TADA_ENABLE_WEB_TOOLS environment variable overrides this when set

update_check.description: Check GitHub for a new Ta-Da release in the background (at most every 6 hours) and say so once per version. Only api.github.com is contacted. The TADA_NO_UPDATE_CHECK environment variable turns it off; tada update always works

trusted_paths.description: Directories whose projects (and every project below them) are trusted without running tada trust. Project-level config (tada.json, tadarc, .tada/tada.json) can run commands, so only list directories you control. Read only from the global config; ~ is expanded.

magic_context.description: Magic Context: background historian, ctx_reduce drops, project memory and search. Replaces auto-summarize when enabled

artifacts.description: Artifacts: HTML pages, Markdown documents and slide decks the agent publishes to a local viewer on 127.0.0.1

budget.description: Spend budgets. When counted spend reaches a limit Ta-Da asks before the next model call. Flat-rate plans are not counted

worktree_dir.description: Directory that holds the Git worktrees /worktree creates. The repository name and branch are appended. Relative paths are resolved against the main checkout; ~ is expanded

sandbox.description: Sandbox for agent shell commands (macOS only). workspace-write lets commands change only the project, temp and build caches; read-only lets them change only temp. Commands that stay in the sandbox with the network off run without asking

sandbox_network.description: Let sandboxed shell commands use the network. When on, commands ask for permission as usual

allowed_tools.description: List of tools that don't require permission prompts

project_allowed_tools.description: File-writing tools that don't require permission prompts when the file is inside the project. Supported: edit, multiedit, write, lsp_replace_symbol

always_ask.description: Action classes that always ask, even in Auto and Edits mode and after allow for session. Classes: read, write, outside, network, delete. Spend always asks

auto_budget.description: Per-session cap on actions of a class that Auto and Edits mode approve before asking again. Keys are classes such as network or outside

base_url.description: Base URL for the provider's API

type.description: Provider type that determines the API format

api_key.description: API key for authentication with the provider

oauth.description: OAuth2 token for authentication with the provider

system_prompt_prefix.description: Custom prefix to add to system prompts for this provider

extra_headers.description: Additional HTTP headers to send with requests

extra_body.description: Additional fields to include in request bodies, only works with openai-compatible providers

provider_options.description: Additional provider-specific options for this provider

aws_auth_refresh.description: Shell command to run when AWS credentials expire (Bedrock only).

discover_models.description: Auto-discover models from /v1/models endpoint. When true with existing models they are merged (yours win)

models.description: List of models available from this provider

model.description: The model ID as used by the provider API

provider.description: The model provider ID that matches a key in the providers config

reasoning_effort.description: Reasoning effort level for OpenAI models that support it

think.description: Enable thinking mode for Anthropic models that support reasoning

max_tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens for model responses

presence_penalty.description: Presence penalty to increase topic diversity

provider_options.description: Additional provider-specific options for the model

compact_mode.description: Enable compact mode for the TUI interface

diff_mode.description: How the TUI draws diffs: unified (inline), split (side by side), or auto (side by side when the window is wide enough)

active_theme.description: Name of the currently active theme

transparent.description: Enable transparent background for the TUI interface

mouse.description: Enable terminal mouse capture for selection, clicks, and scrolling in the TUI. Disable to let the terminal emulator or tmux handle text selection and copy/paste

exit_banner.description: Exit banner style after quitting Ta-Da

intro.description: Play the short animated intro when the TUI starts. Any key skips it. TADA_NO_INTRO=1 also turns it off

text_width.description: Widest chat text may grow, in columns. 0 fills the whole chat area

rich_blocks.description: Draw markdown tables and chart code blocks in replies as styled tables and charts. TADA_NO_RICH=1 also turns it off

fold_tools.description: Fold a finished turn's tool calls and intermediate notes into one 'Worked for …' line that expands on click. The final answer, errors and approval requests stay visible

ambient.description: Draw a calm line above the editor while the agent works. It breathes slowly and shifts color as the agent thinks, reads, edits or runs commands. TADA_NO_AMBIENT=1 also turns it off

limit_rings.description: Path to a local JSON file with AI plan usage (5 hour and weekly percent per provider) to show in the sidebar. Some other tool writes the file; Ta-Da only reads it and never fetches the numbers. Empty turns it off

notify_bell.description: Ring the terminal bell when a session you are not looking at starts waiting for you, finishes or fails

vertical_tabs.description: List session tabs in the sidebar instead of the tab bar above the chat whenever the sidebar is shown

claude_sessions.description: Show the interactive Claude Code sessions running on this machine in the sidebar and notify when one starts waiting for you. Reads the local session files under ~/.claude/sessions only

restore_tabs.description: Reopen the session tabs (with their groups) from the last run in this project on start

timeout.description: Timeout for the glob tool call
Timeout for the grep tool call

max_depth.description: Maximum depth for the ls tool

max_items.description: Maximum number of items to return for the ls tool
